_about: App 1's demo script for the cloned voice. Each line is [id, what the voice says, caption text if it differs]. Numbers are written as spoken. 'Sohan' is respelled by Fusion Voice Studio's pronunciations.json, never here.

lines: s01a
Hi, I'm Sohan. This is an equipment inspection app I built in Power Apps Canvas, on Dataverse.
s01b
It's one of two builds of the same app, made to find exactly where Canvas stops.
s02a
Inspectors check forklifts and conveyors across three warehouse sites.
s02b
They need a checklist that changes with each answer, a live risk score, and photos of any defect.
s03a
The home screen lists every inspection, with its status and its risk.
s03b
Four of these twelve are high or critical, so the problems stand out straight away.
s04a
A new inspection starts with the site, then the equipment.
s04b
This forklift is high criticality, so every risk point counts one and a half times.
s05a
The checklist is a tree stored in Dataverse, and it grows as you answer.
s05b
This forklift is out of service, with damage in the hydraulics, and fluid is leaking.
s05c
No spill kit has been deployed. That's level five, and the score is fifty-two point five, high.
s06a
The next question is at level six, and it's a critical safety stop.
s06b
It never appears. Power Fx functions can't call themselves, so there's one formula per level, and the app stops at five.
s07a
Change the first answer to yes, and the whole branch closes. Its points go with it.
s07b
Now the operator has no valid licence. Forty-five points would only be medium, but a critical stop forces the top band.
s08a
Inspectors can add a photo, and mark the defect with the pen.
s08b
It's freehand only, and the strokes save apart from the photo. That's another limit I measured.
s09a
Review lists every answer, and shows how the score was worked out.
s09b
Submit saves it to Dataverse, and the new inspection goes straight to the top of the list.
s10a
Under the hood it's six Dataverse tables, five screens, and over three and a half thousand lines of Power Fx source.
s10b
Twenty-three Playwright tests drive the published app, and check what it saved in Dataverse.
s10c
All of this is sample data, in a developer environment.
s11a
The next build moves the checklist and the photo markup into code components.
s11b
The full build, the tests and the scripts are on my GitHub, and there's more on my portfolio. Thanks for watching.
